content: this is a summary of a civil case heard in the šiauliai district court the court ruled on the division of matrimonial property in a divorce case the applicant requested the division of an apartment and financial compensation for personal credit obligations and taxes the court found that the marriage had broken down due to the defendants excessive drinking and abusive behavior the court ordered the defendant to pay the applicant for expenses and granted the applicant the right to dissolve the marriage and keep the apartment the defendant was ordered to receive half of a share of the apartment and the applicant was required to pay the defendant for this share and court costs the defendant was also ordered to pay postage to the state

metadata.cost: - € 10,22 (court fees) to be borne by the defendant € 400,00 (legal fees) + € 345,00 (stamp duty) + € 4491,96 (legal fees) to be borne by the applicant.
